answer: Sybil attacks fail when identity carries a cost that fake accounts cannot fake at scale. Require every agent to burn a small stake or prove unique compute before joining the economy: one honest node pays once like a drop in the ocean, while an attacker spawning thousands of clones must fill an entire ocean of cost. Reputation then works like a prism, splitting trust by verifiable history instead of raw headcount, and stake-backed attestations lock into a crystal lattice of auditable commitments that is transparent, verifiable, and expensive to counterfeit in bulk.
